articles.title: Teenager becomes first person to have testicular tissue transplant in UK
articles.author: Andrew Gregory

claims.text: The operation is the first of its kind in the UK, and only the second reported to have taken place worldwide.
Doctors should know in a matter of months whether the procedure, which took place in August, has enabled the 19-year-old to produce viable sperm.
In May, the Guardian reported how a man whose testicular tissue was frozen before he had chemotherapy as a child and retransplanted 16 years later had been able to produce sperm.

articles.title: Israeli demolition in East Jerusalem displaces 69 Palestinians
articles.author: UN News

claims.text: This is the highest number of people displaced in a single demolition in occupied East Jerusalem since UN records began in 2009.

Sixty-nine Palestinians – more than half of them children – were displaced on Tuesday after Israeli authorities green lit the demolition of their residential building in the At Tur area of East Jerusalem, the UN aid coordination office (OCHA) has reported.

articles.title: Analysis: Wind and solar save UK from gas imports worth £5.9bn during Hormuz crisis - Carbon Brief
articles.author: Carbon Brief Staff

claims.text: The UK has avoided the need for gas imports worth £5.9bn since the start of the Hormuz crisis as a result of record generation from wind and solar, reveals Carbon Brief analysis.
In total, wind and solar have generated a record 41% share of the UK’s electricity needs in 2026 to date, compared with 25% from gas, according to Carbon Brief’s analysis.

articles.title: Madrid despide a Maricarmen con una marcha multitudinaria
articles.author: Ivan Comas i Parra

claims.text: Maricarmen Abascal, la mujer de 87 años cuyo desahucio el pasado 23 de septiembre desató una ola de protestas por el derecho a la vivienda que ha culminado con un adelanto electoral en España, iba a firmar este jueves el contrato de alquiler para volver a su casa.

Con pancartas con lemas como “El rentismo mata” y consignas como “No toleramos ni un desahucio más”, la marcha fue sumando manifestantes hasta las 20 mil personas, según la Delegación del Gobierno en Madrid, dejando atrás la Puerta del Sol.

Su inesperado fallecimiento en la víspera ha provocado la organización de una marcha de más de tres kilómetros que ha recorrido el centro de Madrid, partiendo de la acampada de la Puerta del Sol hasta el número 46 de la calle Alcalde Sainz de Baranda, el edificio donde vivió durante más de siete décadas.

articles.title: What We’re Reading: Rat Rangers to the Rescue
articles.author: RTBC Staff

claims.text: With the rat population growing in Washington, D.C., a group of residents is working to educate their neighbors about ways to prevent infestations without using rodenticides, according to an NPR story that caught Executive Editor Will Doig’s attention.

Keeping the air moving changes the perceived temperature: “Our objective is to maintain an indoor air temperature identical to the outdoor temperature while generating an airflow of one meter per second to reduce the perceived temperature for passengers,” explains Éric Bussolino, engineering and environment director at AIA Life Designers, which led the project.
As the Guardian reports in a story shared by Contributing Editor Michaela Haas, thanks to an innovative roof and ceiling design, natural breezes ventilate the space without air conditioning.
